notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
🍬 Hey Players! 🍬

We’ve just rolled out a new update for Candy Shop Simulator and we’ve packed in some tweaks, fixes and cool new tools to make your candy–making life easier (and tastier 😋). Here’s what’s new:

✨ Patch Notes:

 Slight optimization improvements for smoother gameplay
 Improved 3rd person camera – now placed more to the side so it won’t block your view
 Added a crosshair for better precision
 Added new help tips to guide you along the way
 Fixed the serving plate (no more funky behavior there 🍽️)
 Introduced the Duplicator – it can duplicate your creations (not only the final ones!)
 Added an Advanced Mixer that automatically pulls ingredients straight from your pantry 🥣
 Product prices are now calculated based on the ingredients you used
 Looking at a shelf or product display now shows you the quantity available
 Cooling & baking times reduced to just 5 seconds ⏱️
 Hand mixer now works without you having to stir manually 🎉


We hope these changes make your candy shop a smoother, sweeter experience. Thanks for all your feedback! It really helps us shape the game! 💌

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team 🍬

notes.title: Release Date for Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start!
notes.notes:
Hello Candy Lovers! 👋
We're happy to announce that Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start will soon be ready for you to enjoy! 🔥
When?
On August 25, 2025 at 12:00 PM CEST!
Join us in another chapter of our development! 👇 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645040/Candy_Shop_Simulator_Sweet_Start
What is Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start?

It is a standalone free experience sprinkled by the culmination of our recent development. 🧁
We talked about a lot of exciting things in our devlogs and we want you to finally experience it!  🤩

It is newer, with more mechanics, more everything. 

It is a build much closer to our full release, so now feedback, thoughts and ideas on new mechanics and elements that you want to see will be more precious than ever.  
Let's create this bakery together! 🍬

What is different from the demo? 

In Sweet Start you will be able to:

 Buy ice cream from factory 🍦
 Create cakes, not just cookies and lollipops 🎂
 More decorations for your creations 🍰
 More furniture 🪑
 More products to buy in shops 🛒
 Have an employee to take care of your customers 👱
 Expand your shop by buying additional land 🏪

If you are excited as we are, want to join the hype, have  plenty of things you want to see in the game, come join us on our discord!  💬
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png

See you soon!
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: 🍬 Demo | Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello sweet-tooth fans!

We’re excited to announce a fresh update for the Candy Shop Simulator Demo! Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made several improvements to make managing your candy empire even sweeter:

✨ What’s new:

 Updated mechanics for a more enjoyable experience

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: 🍬 Demo | Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey Candy Shop Owners! 🍭🍦 

A fresh update has just arrived, bringing some sweet improvements to your candy empire! We've made the tutorial smoother, optimized a few mechanics, and added some quality-of-life changes. Check out what’s new:  

🔧 Patch Notes:

 Shorter & optimized tutorial – Product purchases have been streamlined, and some steps and text have been removed for a faster experience.  
 Fixed product ordering in tutorial – No more getting stuck due to a lack of money when ordering products.  
 Building mode improvement – Trees will now disappear when the camera gets too close.  
 Ice cream serving fix – Flavor order no longer matters when serving ice cream. Mix it up however you like! 🍦  
 Faster deliveries – The delivery truck now arrives quicker, so you can restock even faster! 🚛💨  



We also recently added a new **in-game bug report window**, making it easier for you to send us any issues you find. We really appreciate your feedback, so don’t hesitate to use it! 🛠️

Thanks for all the submissions you've made so far using this new tool in the game! It greatly improves our communication with you and speeds up the appearance of future updates. 
We are very grateful to you for your involvement.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/e05ab14a56c78f3743e34187addccbd68f652f10.png

Happy candy-making! 🍬✨

notes.title: 🍬 Demo | Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone! ✨

A new update for the demo version of Candy Shop Simulator is ready to download! ✅

We’ve been listening to your feedback and made some sweet improvements to make the experience even better! Here’s what’s new:
 Added a bug report window from the pause menu
 Fixed the possibility of getting stuck in the mini tutorial for making lollipops if the inventory was full
 Feedback form via Google Form
 Improved the appearance of buttons in the lollipop crafting station
 Added missing translations
 Improved camera movement to be less dependent on the number of fps. Specifically, in construction mode rotation and zoom, for the player rotation, on the bike rotation
 Improved bike control to be less dependent on the number of fps
 The lead character in the tutorial moves faster to the store
 Support for setting up furniture in the tutorial
Try out the updated Candy Shop Simulator Demo Version now and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps us make the game even sweeter! 🍭

See you in the shop! 
Candy Shop Simulator Team
